name: starter
description: One lane: an agent does the task, then the host runs this project's verify command on the committed work.

author.description: Does the task and commits the work.

verify.description: Runs this project's checks on a clean checkout. Exits 0 only when they pass.

protected.description: The change touches no CI, agent configuration, factory or lock file.

tests-kept.description: No test was deleted, skipped or weakened.

verify.description: The project's own checks pass on the committed work.

agent.prompt: Do the task below. Commit your work. In your hand-off, say what you changed and how it can be checked.
